europe_now.title: Russian double‑tap drone strike kills 15 in Ukrainian mall
europe_now.summary: Two civilians were killed when a Russian drone struck a shopping centre in Ukraine. Officials confirmed the incident occurred during a busy market area.

sources.headline: Russian double-tap drone strike kills 15 in Ukrainian mall, officials say

europe_now.title: Extreme summer weather devastates European health and agriculture
europe_now.summary: Record temperatures across the continent have caused widespread crop failures and increased health risks. The severe weather also disrupted transportation and energy supply chains.

sources.headline: What a record-breaking El Nino could mean for the world

top_stories.title: Escalating hostilities in eastern Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Ongoing Russian attacks have intensified with multiple strikes targeting civilian infrastructure. Defense authorities report significant changes in troop deployments and strategic planning.
